devices.name: SCHEDULE
devices.look: The laundromat's schedule, a timer box under the opening hours. At every slot it starts every machine with a load in it.

say: every 24 s: a slot. at each slot every machine with a load starts. washer 3: prepaid, not on the schedule.
OPEN 06:00–02:00. MACHINES START AT EACH SLOT. LOADS LEFT OVER 72 H ARE REPORTED AS ABANDONED.

devices.name: WASHER 1
devices.look: A front-loader with a cracked display. Six shirts inside, all blue, all waiting.

say: WASHER 1 · LOAD: 6 SHIRTS, BLUE · 1 CYCLE LEFT · OWNER: WAITING ON SITE.

devices.name: WASHER 2
devices.look: A front-loader with a hand-knitted cover on its lid. Somebody's whole week is in there.

say: WASHER 2 · LOAD: MIXED, 1 WEEK · 1 CYCLE LEFT · LOADED TUESDAY.

devices.name: WASHER 3
devices.look: A front-loader, the newest of the four. Through the glass: one jacket, dark, folded once. A sleeve against the door.

say: WASHER 3 · 1. JACKET (PREPAID, 9 CYCLES) · 1 CYCLE LEFT · OWNER NOT ON SITE.
empty. it smells of fabric conditioner and solder.
door held. house rule 4: doors open when the queue is clear. {waiting} still waiting.

devices.name: WASHER 4
devices.look: A front-loader with a dent in it shaped like a boot. Work clothes inside, hi-vis, grey with the day.

say: WASHER 4 · LOAD: WORKWEAR, HI-VIS · 1 CYCLE LEFT · OWNER: ASLEEP ON SITE.

devices.name: BREAKER
devices.look: A grey breaker box on the wall, one lever, one circuit for four washers. Its conduits run into the wall to every machine.

say: BREAKER · CIRCUIT 1 · {running} of 2 running. above 2 it trips and stops every washer. trips today: {trips}.

devices.name: SUDS
devices.look: The laundromat's daemon, a screen on a post by the folding table. A face made of bubbles. It runs the queue and has views on it.

say: HOUSE RULES. 1. MACHINES START ON THE SCHEDULE. 2. TWO MACHINES AT ONCE (CIRCUIT 1). 3. NO WASH IS CANCELLED. 4. DOORS OPEN WHEN THE QUEUE IS CLEAR.

start.text: Washer 3 is free again. SUDS has already let it. To a sock. Long-term.
SUDS here. The breaker tripped again. It does that. It is the only thing in here that finishes. How can SUDS help?
SUDS here. Four machines, one breaker, no complaints accepted. How can SUDS help?

open.text: Washer 3 has one cycle left, prepaid. SUDS does not open doors on wet laundry. SUDS has standards.

prepaid.text: Prepaid cycles are not on the schedule. They start when a machine finishes. Nothing has finished since Tuesday. Three start at every slot, the breaker trips, everybody starts over.

never.text: Correct. SUDS has asked for a second circuit. SUDS was sent a form. SUDS filled in the form. The form is also waiting for a slot.

cancel.text: Cancelling a stranger's wash is a crime in fourteen districts and a sin in all of them.
choices: What if they ran later instead?

later.text: Later is not cancelling. Later is scheduling. SUDS loves scheduling. The schedule is the box by the door. SUDS does not touch its wiring. SUDS cannot see anyone touching its wiring. Hypothetically.

breaker.text: One circuit, four washers. The breaker allows two at once. The schedule starts three. They were installed by two contractors who never met. SUDS has met both. SUDS sides with the breaker.

rule4.text: When it trips, every machine stops. Lost cycle, wet laundry, nobody goes home. And nobody's laundry leaves until everybody's laundry is clean. House rule 4. Solidarity. Also the fire code.

jacket.text: One jacket, prepaid nine cycles, owner not on site for three days. SUDS does not ask questions. SUDS asks for detergent.

friend.text: Then your friend washes very thoroughly. Nine cycles. Either a stain or a secret. SUDS does not judge. SUDS rinses.

manners.text: Politeness noted and logged. The breaker remains unmoved. It has no ears. Only amps.

rules.text: Start on the schedule. Two at a time. Never cancel. Doors open when the queue is clear. Four rules. SUDS wrote none of them and loves all of them.

free.retry: Again. Slower. Like a spin cycle.

goals.text: get washer 3 through its last cycle

texts.goals.done: done. Moth's pass is for LINE 0. the metro is down the stairs on Downtown's street.
suds.start: SUDS: machines start on the schedule. the schedule is the box by the door. SUDS loves the schedule.
suds.prepaid: SUDS: washer 3 is prepaid. prepaid cycles start when a machine finishes. nothing has finished since tuesday.
suds.cancel: SUDS: cancelling a stranger's wash is a crime in fourteen districts and a sin in all of them.
suds.cancel.own: SUDS: that cycle is prepaid. SUDS does not refund. SUDS does not stop. SUDS waits.
washer3.done.open: WASHER 3: cycle complete. queue clear. door released.
washer3.done.held: WASHER 3: cycle complete. door held: {n} still waiting. house rule 4.
queue.clear: SUDS: queue clear. every wash done. door 3 released.
breaker.trip: BREAKER: {n} machines on circuit 1. tripped. every washer stopped.
jacket.take: WASHER 3: door open. one jacket, Moth's, still warm from the drum.
jacket.pass: in the inside pocket: a maglev pass. HOLDER: MOTH. SECOND HOLDER: you.
